entity.summary: Self-custody hardware-wallet ecosystem centered on Cypherock X1, which distributes wallet key material across an X1 Vault and four X1 Cards.
entity.notes: Current first-party Cypherock documentation describes the X1 as a self-custody hardware wallet whose key shards are held across user-controlled hardware components. Initial product/company launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Cypherock X1 hardware wallet that distributes wallet key material across an X1 Vault and four user-controlled X1 Cards.
products.notes: Current official store provides Add to cart / Buy Now controls, supporting on_sale. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Cypherock X1 launched in private beta
events.description: Cypherock states that the X1 hardware vault launched in private beta in 2022.
events.notes: The source establishes private beta in 2022 only. WLR does not convert this to general availability or infer a more precise date.

events.title: Unstoppable Wallet Android 0.50.1 released
events.description: The official Horizontal Systems Unstoppable Wallet Android repository published version 0.50.1 on 2026-08-27 with GitHub and Google Play APK artifacts, providing dated first-party evidence of continuing wallet maintenance.

evidence.title: Cypherock Introduction
evidence.notes: First-party Cypherock docs identify Cypherock X1 as a self-custody hardware wallet project and describe the project's self-sovereignty mission.

evidence.title: Cypherock X1
evidence.notes: Current official store establishes active X1 purchase availability and explains that the X1 Vault never stores complete private keys.
